_comment: Routing-coupling map for check-skill-receipt.mjs. Globs are scoped to TrackPoli's OWN source and to *.sql / docs/adr, so vendoring the engine under .claude/skills/** or editing always-on/** never force-couples a skill. Each gap found later becomes one more rule here.
